description: An MMCM in a top clock row two regions from the BUFG tile reaches its BUFGs on dedicated clock routing
exercises: route_clocks reaching a BUFG from an MMCM that is not adjacent to it

log_absent: routing clock 'o[01]'\s+Info:\s+failed to find a route using dedicated resources

why: Until openXC7/nextpnr#104 the chipdb generator dropped the CK_BUFG_CASCO <- CK_BUFG_CASCIN pips of every CLK_HROW_TOP tile (gen/filters.py), the only dedicated way to a BUFG from a clock row that is not next to the BUFG tile. An MMCM in the top row of an xc7a35t (X0Y2) had no dedicated path to its BUFGs: route_clocks said so for both outputs and router2 took the fabric, about 4 ns of delay the timing analysis does not see. Vivado uses those pips. Release 2026-10-14 still routes so; this test fails if the warning on the MMCM outputs comes back. The pattern names the two MMCM outputs (o0, o1): the pad that clocks the MMCM has no dedicated path to it from this part's pads and warns either way.
